Issue a seller-authorized consumer offer. ROLE-021 scoped publisher or ROLE-011 assigned advisor with explicit offer-create grant verifies seller authority and exact authorized price/terms evidence. Buyer must own the named request and listing must be available without an exclusive auction channel. Currency matches listing; expiry is future and within approved policy. Server derives seller and verifies clean scoped evidence. An offer alone does not reserve the vehicle or create a transaction.

Read own consumer offer. Named buyer, verified seller or assigned scoped advisor may see permitted terms; internal seller authority evidence remains separately restricted. Expired status is derived from authoritative time and persisted idempotently.

Accept current consumer offer. Only named verified buyer with fresh purpose-bound step-up may accept. Lock idempotency receipt, listing/channel reservation and offer in deterministic order; recheck buyer, current price/terms, seller authority, no auction reservation and trusted time before expiry. Atomically consume one exclusive listing reservation, record consent and accepted offer, create one TransactionCase plus pending OwnershipTransfer, and write audit/outbox. Another buyer wins the reservation at most once; conflicting offer returns 409 listing_unavailable. Replay returns same transaction after current access check. This acceptance does not imply legal contract execution, settled funds or custody.

Withdraw an unaccepted consumer offer. Verified seller or assigned advisor with recorded seller authority may withdraw issued offer; explicit reason, current version and audit required. Acceptance and withdrawal serialize on the same offer and listing locks; accepted offers cannot be retroactively withdrawn and require a legal transaction case.

Read approved public editorial or help content. Return only published current revision; ignore preview credentials on this public cache route. Blocks contain typed safe text/media/link references, never executable HTML. Retired content follows approved redirect/tombstone policy.
